title: An L² Einstein Gap for Nonnegatively Curved Four-Manifolds
summary: We prove a universal, scale-invariant L 2 gap for the trace-free Ricci tensor on simply connected closed four-manifolds with nonnegative sectional curvature. If the trace-free Ricci energy is sufficiently small, the manifold is diffeomorphic to S 4 , $`\mathbb{CP}^2`$, or $`S^2\times S^2`$. The proof uses the classification of positive-Einstein, nonnegatively curved four-manifolds supplied by the companion zero-plane rigidity theorem, stated explicitly as the classification premise of our result.
